title: Opening a call and setting the agenda

grammar.title: Present simple vs present continuous per gli aggiornamenti di stato

examples.en: We're currently migrating the batch to the new cluster.
The job runs every night at two.
I'm looking into the error right now.
The service calls the bank API twice a day.

grammar.italianTrap: Gli italiani dicono spesso 'I work on it now': in inglese serve il continuous, 'I'm working on it now'.

phrases.en: The purpose of today's call is to review the incident.
phrases.it: Lo scopo della call di oggi è rivedere l'incident.

phrases.en: There are three points I'd like to cover.
phrases.it: Ci sono tre punti che vorrei trattare.

phrases.en: Let's start with the batch failure.
I'll share my screen in a second.
phrases.it: Condivido lo schermo tra un secondo.

phrases.en: We have about thirty minutes, so let's keep it focused.
phrases.it: Abbiamo circa trenta minuti, restiamo concentrati.

quiz.why: Dopo una preposizione il verbo va in -ing: 'for joining'.
Routine ripetuta: present simple, terza persona con -s.
Azione in corso in questo momento: present continuous.

options: There are two points I'd like to cover.

quiz.q: 'The service ___ the bank API twice a day.'
quiz.why: Frequenza abituale ('twice a day'): present simple.

gapfill.text: Could you ___ me through the error?

reorder.answer: There are three points I'd like to cover
The purpose of today's call is to review the incident

fluency.prompt: You are hosting the call. Greet the partner bank, state the purpose and list two agenda points. 30 seconds.
fluency.model: Thanks everyone for joining. The purpose of today's call is to review yesterday's batch failure. There are two points I'd like to cover: first the root cause, then the plan for tonight's run.

fluency.prompt: Someone joins late. Welcome them and summarise where you are in one sentence. 20 seconds.
fluency.model: Hi, welcome. We've just started; we're currently going through the root cause of the batch failure.

fluency.prompt: Say what your team does every day and what you are doing right now about the incident. 40 seconds.
fluency.model: Our team runs the nightly reconciliation and monitors the batch every morning. Right now we're analysing the logs and we're working with the vendor on a fix.
